packs.title: Readiness, recovery and current contracts
packs.purposeAndActions: Hash-pin archived evidence, exact current source, deployed binaries and provider configuration. Run canonical product and selected Court/diplomacy/family/reputation/persistence contracts once; reuse compatible reports.
packs.fixtureContract: No native mutation; current task source hashes and exact protected baseline required.
packs.independentOracle: Authoritative native/server pre-state and post-state, exact balances/custody/treaties/directional pair/loyalty, immutable receipt and world-history IDs, visible transcript and production controls. Never fixture expected values alone.
packs.rollback: Restore exact finalized run-owned checkpoint before conflicting/destructive variant; never overwrite protected baseline.
packs.completion: Every listed requirement individually passed, compatible evidence attached, or explicit unresolved gap; pack completion does not imply unchecked variants passed.

packs.title: Daily docket and Chancellor
